description.value: La Petite Cuillère is a well-established English-style tea house anchored in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, featuring a dramatically decorated interior with vaulted ceilings, custom chandeliers, and velvet couches. The kitchen blends teas in-house and builds its daily menu around tea-infused dishes prepared by a chef de pâtissier, with strong accommodation for vegan, gluten-free, and nut-free diets. Takeaway pastries and loose-leaf teas sold by the bag make it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the area.
